_comment_macros: gf180_j4mmu 2 KB-cache harden (Task 8, run.sh macro=icache_2k): sibling of ../icache/config.json (8 KB) and ../icache_4k/config.json (4 KB spike). icache_adapter_gf180 now binds its tag RAM to ram_3x8x64_1rw (3x vendor sram64x8m8wm1 macros, one per 8-bit lane of the widened 24-bit tag -- see lib/memory_tech_lib/tech/gf180/ram_3x8x64_1rw_gf180.vhd) and its data RAM to ram_2x8x512_2rw (2x[outer loop]x2 cols = 4x sram512x8m8wm1 macros, no row tiling needed since 512-deep maps 1:1 onto the macro -- see ram_2x8x512_2rw_gf180.vhd). Instance path names below follow the flattened hierarchy pattern captured in ../icache_4k/config.merged.json's real OpenROAD run (u_ucache_ram.tag.subword_gen:N.sram_i / u_ucache_ram.ram:N.ram_s.col_gen:M.sram_i -- the generic ram_1rw/ram_2rw 'rows'/'genram_*'/'mem' generate labels are elided by ghdl-yosys for these single-branch generate-if selections, unlike the 8 KB config's paths which predate that observation) -- NOT verified against this specific netlist's own OpenROAD unplaced-macro warnings (no prior run of icache_2k exists yet); if OpenROAD.GeneratePDN reports unplaced macros, capture the real paths from its warning log and fix this file before retrying. Macros are hand-arranged on the same 452 um column pitch / 505 um row pitch as ../icache/config.json: data macros (4x sram512x8, 2 rows of 2 cols) at the bottom, tag macros (3x sram64x8) as a third row above. DIE_AREA/CORE_AREA reduced vs the 8 KB config (2 KB is ~1/4 the SRAM) but kept on the same proven column pitch/width for placement safety margin.
